title: Source status focus cards
summary: This iteration turns source status focus from a dense markdown block into four fixed attention cards for actionable, updated-not-selected, stale, and parsed-without-candidate source states.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source status focus renders attention cards" tests/unit.test.js

node --test --test-name-pattern "source status focus renders attention cards|source metrics dashboard cards|source-first IA dashboard|source-first IA contract|source inventory|source map scan index|source display contract governance" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: Source health exceptions need a card-level visual contract.
lessons.evidence: `source-status-focus` now emits an effective-interact `filterable-cards` section with fixed cards for sources needing attention, updated but not selected sources, sources without recent updates, and parsed sources that did not form candidates.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep future source status refinements on the same fixed-card contract so failure and low-signal states remain visible.

lessons.lesson: Empty source status groups should remain visible.
lessons.evidence: The four focus cards are always emitted in fixed order, and groups with no rows show an explicit `暂无` detail instead of disappearing.
lessons.recommended_action: Apply the same explicit-empty pattern when adding new fixed source status groups.

lessons.lesson: The source status focus can become more prominent without changing collection, ranking, or registry behavior.
lessons.evidence: The implementation only changes the interaction report shaping and test contract; source registry, source display contract, collection, ranking, automation, and publishing configuration remain untouched.
lessons.recommended_action: Continue separating presentation iterations from source acquisition or ranking changes.

followups.action: Review the rendered attention cards after the next real daily run to decide whether the source status detail list needs stricter truncation or section anchors.
